reason: My assistant and I already share Gmail, Docs, Chat and one calendar through the Workspace plan I pay for, so this would mean moving everything for $20 more a month. And it says desktop and web only, while half our coordination happens on our phones.
objection: No phone app. If my VA can't check a task or reply in chat from her phone, it's useless to us, and Google already does that.
would_change_my_mind: Real iOS and Android apps plus a two-way sync with our Google Calendar and Gmail, so I'm adding to Workspace instead of replacing it.
